sec.t: ff.129.2 Pi, FigureAI and 1 hour of “logistics”?
sec.p: LLMs aren't just democratising software. They're the simplest interface we've ever had for the physical world - for “talking to robots”.
Basic research aside, here are a few concrete examples.

Leveraging Tesla's know-how and production capacity (self-driving through the streets of Rome?), Musk wants to use robots precisely to colonise Mars (they don't suffer from cosmic rays or from boring interplanetary journeys lasting months).
